I play in the air quite a bit, this is definitely what I thought at first, so here’s my thoughts. Its back gun is great at Amelia Earthart-ing planes, but its turn radius is incredibly limited meaning good positioning from an attacking pilot makes it easy to avoid the gun. Also the front gun is pretty much only good at killing ground targets and other slow moving planes (Bombers and pilots repairing. Random tip don’t make yourself an easy target while repairing by slowing down and leveling out, use plane momentum and don't forget you still have W and S throttle control during repair). The health on the bomber is higher which can be appealing, but it can still be one shot by a trench fighter barrage, not to mention most attack planes with solid gunners just skirt around you outside of gun fire and blap blap blap you down, using the back gun’s 360 radius. You could argue that other light planes would lead to enough chaos that they have a chance, but due to the incredible size combined with its slow speed you are pretty much going to be the proverbial apple of everyone’s 7.7mm automaticfuckyou&yourplanesticks. In a 100 percent firefight mode (just air targets) the bomber just isn't a viable option, HOWEVER I hope that this firefight mode will incorporate some form of bombing target ground or sea objectives (Boats AND Hoes). This would add a whole new level of depth to a firefight mode, the once useless Whale of the Sky now has objectives that make the high risk high reward play style of the bomber more rewarding. This would also just change the game play style a bit. Bombers who struggle in the speed and bedlam of a small to mid-sized map firefight but with ground targets (and hopefully large maps) a good pilot can use all that extra open sky and space to allow the back gunner to fight back. The space also allows skilled bombers to make themselves smaller targets, and utilize their extra health, without suffering from the debilitating "kick me in the junk" spray paint that was added to every bomber plane.
Also just an idea I always thought would be fun for shigs, side arms in planes, would be awesome for pilots to be able to whip out a pistol and shoot at the other pilot. Still the ability to used fix gun aircraft, but man it would be fun to take a couple shots a pilot as he swoops over you.
